name: Butler University
academic_ranking: Butler University is a private university founded in 1855 with a total enrollment of about 5,746 students and an average class size of 21. Butler is ranked the No. 1 Regional University in the Midwest (U.S. News) and was named one of Jeffrey Selingo's 75 'New Dream Schools.' It reports a 98% placement rate (employed or in graduate school) for 2024 graduates. Known for a student-centered model blending liberal arts with professional training.
financial_aid: 2026-27 undergraduate tuition is $50,860 (total cost of attendance approx. $75,080 including housing/food, fees, and indirect costs). 96% of first-year students received gift aid in 2024-25. All first-year applicants are automatically considered for the Academic Scholarship Program with awards ranging $18,000-$30,000. Merit scholarships for academics and athletics, need-based aid via FAFSA (school code 001788), work-study, loans, and a Loan Repayment Assistance Program (LRAP) are available. Financial Aid Office: 317-940-8200, finaid@butler.edu.
facilities_notes: Butler softball competes as an NCAA Division I program on the Butler University campus in Indianapolis, IN. Specific stadium/facility details were not confirmed from a live page (softball facility page returned an error 2026-07); not stated to avoid guessing.
